content: A delegation of psychiatrists met Chief Minister V.D. Satheesan at Thiruvananthapuram and submitted a memorandum seeking reforms in mental healthcare delivery, infrastructure and governance

title: Suspense continues over Karnataka Cabinet expansion as Congress delays final decision
content: Suspense over the expansion of the Karnataka Cabinet continued on Wednesday, with the Congress high command once again deferring a final decision on the list of legislators to be inducted

title: Madhya Pradesh hikes moong procurement cap to 60% as farmers protest
content: The decision comes as nearly 2,000 farmers, who breached police barricades to reach the State capital, set up camp near Chief Minister Mohan Yadav’s residence

content: Initial inquiry revealed that special teams were formed in Ranipet to prevent illegal sand mining, smuggling of ganja and other banned substances

title: Kerala Police Association moves High Court against Home dept.’s order restructuring police forums
content: ACS (Home) ordered restructuring of KPA including all ranks from CPOs to grade SIs, and revamp of KPSOA by including ranks from SI to SP (non-IPS). The move renders another association, KPOA, redundant. KPA contends that each forum has its own objectives and questions the ACS authority to pass such an order

title: NHAI removes 361 encroachments from national highways after Supreme Court order
content: The nationwide drive ensured a ‘smooth and effective enforcement’ of removing illegal access points, encroachments, unauthorised structures and median cuts along highways, the NHAI said in a statement

title: Karnataka High Court questions conduct of Malur judicial officer on public road; stays FIR registered against three for overtaking her car
content: Taking serious exception to the conduct of a judicial officer on a public road, the High Court of Karnataka stayed the investigation against three persons based on a First Information Report registered against them for allegedly overtaking a private car of the judicial officer at Malur in Kolar district

title: Anti-corruption drive ‘Project Zero’ launched in Kerala
content: Home Minister Ramesh Chennithala said that the project is aimed at catching not just bribe takers, but those giving bribes too

content: Being established by Tata Power Renewable Energy Limited, the projects are coming up at Kanekal in Anantapur district and Pattikonda in Kurnool district

title: CJP protest | Fresh reports of detentions, takedown of social media posts emerge
content: Multiple reports of people, including minors, being detained or arrested by the police, and social media users being asked to take down posts related to the demonstrations have come to the fore

title: CPI(M) Ernakulam district secretary accuses State govt., MP of inaction over FACT crisis
content: Hibi Eden rejects the allegations, saying he had raised FACT-related issues in Parliament and sought action on a nano urea plant

title: Centre’s assurance cannot override statutory processes governing withdrawal of FIRs, experts say
content: ‘Once an FIR has been registered, it cannot simply be cancelled; police can file a closure report if it finds no material to proceed or the public prosecutor may seek withdrawal from prosecution; however, court can reject them and still order a fresh probe'

content: Anita Dipke said that the intimidation forced the parents to flee their home and take shelter at a relative's residence in the Konkan region for 16 days

title: BJP alleges Rahul Gandhi spread misinformation on police action, demands apology

content: The Bill enhances penalties for offenders, individuals found guilty of paper leaks or other unfair means in public examinations will face imprisonment ranging upto 10 years and fines of up to ₹50 lakh while organised rackets will attract a minimum sentence of seven years and fines of up to ₹10 crore

content: The GCC has directed all property owners with pending dues to clear their arrears before July 31 to avoid penal interest and further enforcement proceedings

title: Bombay High Court quashes Mumbai Police externment order against SDPI members
content: The FIRs against two members of the Social Democratic Party of India pertain to just sloganeering, with no harm to the public or property, the court says

title: No abnormality in fuel switch of Air India’s Boeing 787 grounded in February, Centre tells Parliament

content: Case in connection with a YouTube video in which Mohandas said he ‘would have shot' the protestors in Delhi if he were in control

title: Rahul's remarks on student protests trigger Parliament showdown: What happened next
content: The Lok Sabha passed the Public Examinations Amendment Bill amid disruptions and political debate. Rahul Gandhi attacked the government over alleged police action and education privatization. Union ministers rebutted Gandhi's claims, calling them baseless and false allegations. The bill introduces stricter punishments for examination-related offenses and paper leaks. This legislation aims to ensure fairness and prevent unfair means in public examinations.

title: 'Iran is going to get a beating': Trump threatens 'hard' response after attack on US base
content: United States President Donald Trump warned Iran of a forceful military response. American bases in Jordan faced missile attacks which the US intercepted. Iran's Revolutionary Guard claimed responsibility for the attempted surprise strike. US and Saudi forces also conducted overnight strikes against Iran-backed militias. Global markets reacted to the latest escalation in the Middle East.

title: Indian Embassy in US slams foreign media for misleading headline over PoK killings
content: The Indian Embassy criticized The New York Times for its inaccurate reporting.  The embassy stated Pakistan illegally occupies parts of Jammu and Kashmir.  Violent clashes have occurred in Pakistan-occupied Kashmir since early June.  Protests are ongoing over regional legislative assembly seats and alleged manipulation.  India attributes these protests to Pakistan's economic exploitation and oppression.

title: How two solar farms in US restored native wildflowers & proved beneficial for insects
content: Two Minnesota solar farms have reportedly helped restore local ecosystems. Researchers found native wildflowers and grasses increased significantly after five years. Beneficial insect populations, including bees, tripled compared to earlier observations. This development offers evidence that solar farms can aid habitat restoration efforts. Such projects can generate renewable electricity and benefit local biodiversity.

title: Paredes faces 3 assault charges; FIFA charges Argentina over 'Malvinas' banner
content: FIFA initiated disciplinary proceedings against Argentina players and officials.  Charges include assault allegations and unsporting behaviour after the World Cup final.  The Argentine Football Association faces accusations for fan conduct and political demonstrations.  Players and staff may receive match suspensions and financial penalties for their actions.  FIFA will review all submissions before announcing its final verdict.

title: How Europe's heatwave is proving Americans right about air conditioning
content: Europeans are now buying air conditioning units in unprecedented numbers. Manufacturers report significant sales growth across several European countries. This shift is driven by both comfort and public health concerns. Rising temperatures and extreme heat events are becoming impossible to ignore. Cultural attitudes towards cooling solutions are beginning to change.

title: J&K politicians urge UN, PM Modi to intervene over PoK killings
content: Political parties in Jammu and Kashmir are urging intervention over alleged killings. Over two dozen people were reportedly killed in firing by Pakistani security forces. National Conference president Farooq Abdullah called for a UN Human Rights Council team. CPM legislator MY Tarigami demanded an end to force and an inquiry. Unrest has escalated in PoK after authorities banned the Joint Awami Action Committee.

title: Barracuda bites Texas girl, 13, but cannot shake her ocean dream
content: A Texas teenager is recovering after a rare barracuda attack during a family vacation. Claire Macdonel experienced the frightening incident in shallow waters while wearing a shiny bracelet. She is now home and preparing for surgery to repair her hand injury. Despite the painful ordeal, Claire still dreams of becoming a marine biologist. Her family shares the story to raise awareness and encourage water safety precautions.

title: Aliko Dangote plans to give one-third of his $36bn fortune to charity
content: Africa's richest man, Aliko Dangote, will donate one-third of his wealth to charity. This significant philanthropic commitment is part of his succession plan. His daughter, Halima Dangote, revealed this plan in a recent interview. The billionaire's fortune is valued at approximately $36.5 billion. This donation aims to embed philanthropy into the family's long-term vision.

title: JPMorgan CEO recalls his Citigroup firing: Shares meeting with mentor Sandy Weill
content: JPMorgan Chase CEO Jamie Dimon discussed two major life events.  His 1998 Citigroup dismissal reshaped his career path significantly. His youngest daughter asked if the family would now have to “sleep on the streets”. A near-fatal heart emergency in 2020 brought him peace.  Dimon invested heavily in Bank One after leaving Citigroup.  This bold move led to his leadership at JPMorgan Chase.

title: How Savannah James built a thriving business empire beyond LeBron James' fame
content: Savannah James has built a successful career through business, interior design, philanthropy, and community leadership. From launching furniture projects to mentoring young women and working with respected brands, she has created her own identity beyond basketball. While supporting her family, she has continued growing as an entrepreneur, proving that her achievements extend far beyond being LeBron James’ wife.

title: US Federal Reserve meet today: Kevin Warsh-led FOMC keeps interest rates unchanged
content: The US Federal Reserve, which began its two-day policy meeting on Tuesday, was widely expected to leave its benchmark interest rate unchanged.

title: Jammu and Kashmir: Schools closed in Kishtwar, Doda amid inclement weather
content: Authorities ordered school closures in Doda and Kishtwar districts due to inclement weather.  The Amarnath pilgrimage continued solely on the Baltal route with many devotees.  Vaishno Devi yatra also proceeded but only via the traditional Ardhkuwari track.  The Jammu-Srinagar national highway remained open for all vehicular traffic.  The IMD predicted continued rain and potential flash floods across the region.

title: No proof Nicki Nicole dated Lamine Yamal for publicity despite viral claim
content: The viral claim that Nicki Nicole admitted dating Lamine Yamal only for publicity is false. No credible interview, video, or trusted news report contains those alleged comments. The couple publicly dated in 2025 before ending their relationship on good terms. The video shared with the post has been misrepresented and does not include the claimed confession.

title: Lamine Yamal’s emotional tribute to his mother despite childhood struggles
content: Lamine Yamal, the 19-year-old World Cup winner, has spoken openly about a childhood shaped by financial hardship and parental sacrifice. His mother, Sheila Ebana, emigrated from Equatorial Guinea to Spain as a teenager, had Yamal at 16, and raised him largely alone after separating from his father when Lamine was three. Yamal credits her with shielding him from the worst of their circumstances, saying she made him see only the beautiful side of life. He also reflected on his rapid rise at Barcelona, describing himself as a creative and entertaining player who never anticipated reaching the first team quite so quickly

title: Nolan Wells' family seeks social media records amid missing phone data concerns
content: Nolan Wells’ family has subpoenaed several social media companies as investigators continue examining the 18-year-old’s death. The requests focus on account records and digital data after the family raised concerns about missing Snapchat content on Wells’ phone. His friend Warren Hudson has denied that anyone accessed or deleted information from the device. The investigation remains ongoing.

title: Tourists no longer sleep in taxis, Farooq Abdullah hails hotel boom in Kashmir
content: In a recent statement, LG Manoj Sinha commended hotels for their role as facilitators of peace and their significant financial commitments to the sector. He pointed out that numerous hotels had overlooked crucial construction regulations. Farooq Abdullah highlighted the employment opportunities generated by hotels, reminiscing about a time when accommodation options were limited.

title: MP farmers breach barricades, reach within 1 km of CM Mohan Yadav's residence over moong MSP
content: Farmers in Bhopal protested over summer moong procurement at minimum support price. They breached police barricades and marched towards the Chief Minister's residence. The state government formed a committee to discuss issues with farmer representatives. Talks between the agriculture minister and farmer leaders concluded without a breakthrough. The protest continued with various demonstrations and roadside activities.

title: Watch: Terrifying one-punch knockout at CWG leaves boxer hanging through ropes
content: Orlando Holley-Sotomi of Wales delivered a powerful knockout during the Commonwealth Games boxing quarterfinal.  His opponent, Refiloe Thai, was sent through the ropes after a devastating right hand landed.  Medical staff quickly attended to the injured boxer, who thankfully showed signs of recovery.  This victory guarantees Holley-Sotomi at least a bronze medal in the competition.

title: Hyderabad: Trainee IPS officer arrested for sexual harassment of co-trainee
content: A trainee IPS officer was arrested for allegedly harassing a woman co-trainee. The accused faces charges of stalking and sexual harassment at the police academy. He reportedly sent abusive messages and made derogatory remarks to the complainant. The woman also alleged physical assault and blackmail attempts by the officer. Police registered a case under relevant sections of the law.

title: 'Like losing the woman of your life': Mancini apologises after dramatic Italy return
content: Roberto Mancini has apologised for his previous departure from the Italian national team. He admitted his exit was completely his fault and expressed deep regret. Mancini returns as Italy's coach after their World Cup qualification failures. He aims to restore the Azzurri to their former glory and win back trust. The team's new era begins with a UEFA Nations League match.

title: Relief for automakers as Centre proposes easy easing emission compliance testing regime
content: The road transport ministry proposes changes to emission compliance testing for vehicle manufacturers.  New passenger cars and two-wheelers will undergo annual testing for three years after approval.  Larger vehicles will continue with annual emission compliance testing.  Existing models will see testing frequency reduced to once every three years.  This move aims to reduce compliance burdens and improve ease of doing business.

title: Kanpur man kills wife, applies sindoor on her head before hanging self
content: In a tragic incident in Kanpur, a newly married couple, Saurabh Savita and Shalini, were found dead in their rented room. Police speculate that Saurabh may have strangled Shalini before taking his own life, applying vermilion, a symbol of marital status. Their court marriage, done in secrecy without familial approval, had caused considerable tension within their families. Investigations are ongoing to uncover the motive behind this heartbreaking situation.

title: Meta tells IT ministry PM Modi's posts will get additional oversight, senior reviews
content: Meta assured the government of enhanced oversight for Prime Minister Modi's posts. This assurance followed the brief removal of his video addressing the NEET paper leak issue. The company admitted the video's temporary removal was due to an unintended error. Prime Minister Modi had discussed stricter measures against paper leaks in the video. Meta officials will meet government representatives soon to discuss this incident further.

title: Neymar confirms Brazil retirement: 'My time with the national team is over'
content: Neymar has officially confirmed his retirement from international football after a long career.  His decision follows Brazil's recent exit from the FIFA World Cup tournament.  The veteran forward ends his international journey with numerous goals and assists.  He also addressed and dismissed recent dressing-room criticism reports.  Neymar helped Santos secure a victory in the Copa Sudamericana match.

title: Inside US-Saudi nuclear deal: Why Pakistan is biggest loser
content: The newly forged nuclear pact between the US and Saudi Arabia promises to transform the atomic dynamics in the region. This agreement grants Saudi Arabia the ability to enrich uranium domestically, supervised by the United States, effectively diminishing Pakistan's nuclear dominance. The emergence of a nuclear triangle comprising Israel, Iran, and Saudi Arabia signals a significant shift in U.S. non-proliferation efforts, embracing a tiered regional order.

title: Rahul's 'advice' to PM Modi, and 3 guarantees to students over police action on protesters
content: Rahul Gandhi accused the Centre of denying him Lok Sabha speech rights. He refused to apologize for blaming Amit Shah for police brutality. Gandhi demanded the Home Minister's dismissal and an independent probe. He alleged police used pellet guns and nail-fitted lathis on students. Gandhi promised justice and accountability for the injured students.

title: What India needs to do amid emerging global challenges: Finance ministry outlines
content: The report stressed that deeper domestic reforms and quicker policy execution will be essential to alter the country's long-term economic trajectory.

title: India-US trade pact: Piyush Goyal explains the one condition to seal the deal
content: India's trade pact with the US awaits tariff competitiveness restoration for its first phase.  Minister Piyush Goyal stated India needs a comparative advantage over rival nations.  This condition must be met before the bilateral trade agreement can commence.  Meanwhile, a US legislative proposal could impose tariffs on Russian energy buyers.  India has increased its Russian crude oil purchases amid supply disruptions.

title: Five wins, nine medals assured! Indian boxers deliver flawless day at CWG 2026
content: The Commonwealth Games witnessed India's boxing squad achieving an impressive milestone by winning all five matches. Five Indian athletes have now made it to the semifinals, guaranteeing at least nine bronze medals for the country. Sakshi Choudhary and Arundhati Choudhary kick-started the victory parade with their bouts, complemented by the triumphs of Sachin Siwach, Ankush Yadav, and Narender Berwal.

title: Varanasi: Man stabs live-in partner to death after drunken fight over washing utensils
content: A live-in relationship between two gay partners in Varanasi ended tragically on Monday night.  One partner, Kush Pandey, fatally stabbed his live-in partner, Dipanshu Rai, during a quarrel.  The dispute reportedly began over washing dishes after consuming alcohol together.  Police arrested Kush Pandey at the scene and sent Dipanshu Rai's body for postmortem.  The couple had been living together for a year and often argued after drinking.

title: Explained: Why rain can't stop athletics at CWG 2026 despite safety concerns
content: Glasgow's weather challenges the 2026 Commonwealth Games athletics events.  Athletics regulations permit competition in rain if safety is maintained.  Modern facilities and drainage systems manage wet conditions effectively.  Athletes adapt to challenging weather as part of elite competition.  Reserve days are not kept due to complex scheduling and logistical issues.

title: Oil prices jump over 7% as Middle East chaos flares up, brent crude back at $90
content: Oil prices surged over seven percent on Wednesday amid renewed Middle East military actions.  This rally was also supported by industry data showing a drawdown in US crude inventories.  Renewed strikes involving the United States and Iran-backed groups reignited supply concerns.  Disruptions continued to affect shipping through the Strait of Hormuz and Bab el-Mandeb.  Analysts expect oil prices to remain volatile in the near term due to ongoing conflict.

title: India faces 100% Trump tariff threat as US Senate advances Russia Sanctions Bill - what it means
content: India has stepped up Russian crude oil purchases to make up for the deficit, helped in part by the US sanctions waiver which lapsed recently. However, India has continued to procure Russian crude.

title: Duleep Trophy: Sooryavanshi named East Zone vice-captain, Ishan Kishan to lead
content: Vaibhav Sooryavanshi has been appointed vice-captain for the East Zone squad. He will serve as deputy to Ishan Kishan in the Duleep Trophy 2026. Experienced pacer Mohammed Shami also returns to domestic cricket action. The squad features a blend of international cricketers and emerging talent. Riyan Parag and Akash Deep are absent due to rehabilitation.

title: Sooryavanshi jumps 230 places in T20I rankings as Ishan Kishan scripts history
content: Teenage sensation Vaibhav Sooryavanshi has jumped 230 places in the ICC T20I batting rankings. Ishan Kishan retains his world number one position with a historic rating. Tilak Varma and Shreyas Iyer also saw gains in the rankings. Ravi Bishnoi made significant progress in the T20I bowling rankings. Zimbabwe's Ryan Burl and Blessing Muzarabani also achieved career-best rankings.

title: Gujarat Man Poisoned, Buried By Wife. Family Believed He Was In Australia
content: Jignesh Mavadiya's family believed for nearly two years that he was living and working in Australia. Investigators allege that he was poisoned with cyanide and buried about 12 feet beneath the floor of a factory in the Dared GIDC area.

content: The victim was identified as Lanbimei Riamei (22), son of Kadirang Riamei of Longmai Bazar in Noney district.

content: Foods high in fat, trans-fat, sugar and salt, commonly known as HFSS foods, can no longer be sold, given away or promoted within school premises or within a 50-metre radius of them.

content: Although there has been little rainfall since July 21 and the flood situation has improved, Himanta Sarma said the destruction left behind remains severe.

content: In a strongly worded statement issued on Wednesday, the Ukrainian Embassy in India questioned whether New Delhi would once again summon Russia's representative, as it had after an earlier deadly attack involving Indian sailors.

title: Rahul Gandhi Demands Accountability Over Crackdown On Students, BJP Hits Back
content: The BJP has doubled down on its demand that Gandhi apologise. "Let me clearly state the Bharatiya Janata Party's position on Rahul Gandhi and the statement he made in the House: Rahul Gandhi must apologize," said the BJP's Sambit Patra in a separate press conference.
